mapper.select: select p.enterprise_profile_id profile_id, p.previous_profile_id, p.current_version_id, p.enterprise_name, p.unified_credit_code, p.unified_credit_code identity_key, p.enterprise_type, p.legal_representative_name, p.legal_document_type_code, p.legal_document_number, p.established_date, p.business_term_from, p.business_term_until, p.registered_address, p.business_scope, p.contact_name, p.contact_phone, p.email, p.registered_capital, p.industry_code, p.website, p.status, p.version, p.create_time, b.user_id binding_user_id, b.status binding_status from profile_enterprise p left join profile_enterprise_binding b on b.enterprise_profile_id = p.enterprise_profile_id and b.status in ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED') and b.del_flag = '0' where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status != 'REVOKED' and p.status = #{status} and p.enterprise_name like concat('%', #{enterpriseName}, '%') and p.unified_credit_code = #{unifiedCreditCode} order by p.create_time desc, p.enterprise_profile_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select p.enterprise_profile_id profile_id, p.previous_profile_id, p.current_version_id, p.enterprise_name, p.unified_credit_code, p.unified_credit_code identity_key, p.enterprise_type, p.legal_representative_name, p.legal_document_type_code, p.legal_document_number, p.established_date, p.business_term_from, p.business_term_until, p.registered_address, p.business_scope, p.contact_name, p.contact_phone, p.email, p.registered_capital, p.industry_code, p.website, p.status, p.version, p.create_time, b.user_id binding_user_id, b.status binding_status from profile_enterprise p left join profile_enterprise_binding b on b.enterprise_profile_id = p.enterprise_profile_id and b.status in ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED') and b.del_flag = '0' where p.enterprise_profile_id = #{profileId} and p.del_flag = '0'

select p.enterprise_profile_id profile_id, p.previous_profile_id, p.current_version_id, p.enterprise_name, p.unified_credit_code, p.unified_credit_code identity_key, p.enterprise_type, p.legal_representative_name, p.legal_document_type_code, p.legal_document_number, p.established_date, p.business_term_from, p.business_term_until, p.registered_address, p.business_scope, p.contact_name, p.contact_phone, p.email, p.registered_capital, p.industry_code, p.website, p.status, p.version, p.create_time from profile_enterprise p where p.enterprise_profile_id = #{profileId} and p.del_flag = '0' for update

select enterprise_version_id version_id, enterprise_profile_id profile_id, version_no, source_type, source_id, enterprise_name, unified_credit_code, unified_credit_code identity_key, enterprise_type, legal_representative_name, legal_document_type_code, legal_document_number, established_date, business_term_from, business_term_until, registered_address, business_scope, contact_name, contact_phone, email, registered_capital, industry_code, website, status, published_time from profile_enterprise_version where enterprise_profile_id = #{profileId} and del_flag = '0' order by version_no desc

select enterprise_version_id version_id, enterprise_profile_id profile_id, version_no, source_type, source_id, enterprise_name, unified_credit_code, unified_credit_code identity_key, enterprise_type, legal_representative_name, legal_document_type_code, legal_document_number, established_date, business_term_from, business_term_until, registered_address, business_scope, contact_name, contact_phone, email, registered_capital, industry_code, website, status, published_time from profile_enterprise_version where enterprise_profile_id = #{profileId} and status = 'CURRENT' and del_flag = '0' for update

select enterprise_binding_id binding_id, enterprise_profile_id profile_id, user_id, status, binding_version, source_type, source_id, bound_time, unbound_time from profile_enterprise_binding where enterprise_profile_id = #{profileId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc, enterprise_binding_id desc

select enterprise_binding_id binding_id, enterprise_profile_id profile_id, user_id, status, binding_version, source_type, source_id, bound_time, unbound_time from profile_enterprise_binding where enterprise_profile_id = #{profileId} and status in ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED') and del_flag = '0' for update
select count(*) from profile_enterprise_binding where user_id = #{userId} and status in ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED') and del_flag = '0'

select enterprise_source_id source_id, source_type, operator_user_id, operation_reason reason, field_snapshot_json, occurred_time from profile_enterprise_source where enterprise_profile_id = #{profileId} and del_flag = '0' order by occurred_time desc

select operation_audit_id audit_id, operation_type, operator_user_id, capability, reason, before_status, after_status, result, failure_category, occurred_time from profile_operation_audit where profile_type = 'ENTERPRISE' and profile_id = #{profileId} and del_flag = '0' order by occurred_time desc

select a.enterprise_application_id application_id, a.applicant_user_id, a.status, a.submission_seq, a.decision_version, a.version, s.enterprise_submission_id submission_id, s.field_snapshot_json, s.submitted_time from profile_enterprise_application a join profile_enterprise_submission s on s.enterprise_application_id = a.enterprise_application_id and s.submission_seq = a.submission_seq and s.del_flag = '0' where a.enterprise_application_id = #{applicationId} and a.submission_seq > 0 and a.del_flag = '0'

select a.enterprise_application_id application_id, a.applicant_user_id, a.status, a.submission_seq, a.decision_version, a.version, s.enterprise_submission_id submission_id, s.field_snapshot_json, s.submitted_time from profile_enterprise_application a join profile_enterprise_submission s on s.enterprise_application_id = a.enterprise_application_id and s.submission_seq = a.submission_seq and s.del_flag = '0' where a.enterprise_application_id = #{applicationId} and a.status = 'WAITING' and a.del_flag = '0' for update
mapper.update: update profile_enterprise_application set status = 'OVERRIDE_PENDING', decision_version = decision_version + 1, decision_source = 'ADMIN_OVERRIDE', decision_result = #{decision}, decision_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now}, update_by = #{operatorId} where enterprise_application_id = #{applicationId} and status = 'WAITING' and decision_version = #{decisionVersion} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into profile_decision_record(decision_record_id, profile_type, application_id, submission_id, decision_version, decision_source, decision_result, decision_status, operator_user_id, reason, occurred_time, version, create_dept, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, del_flag) values(#{id}, 'ENTERPRISE', #{applicationId}, #{submissionId}, #{decisionVersion}, 'ADMIN_OVERRIDE', #{decision}, 'PENDING', #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{now}, 0, -1, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId}, '0')
mapper.update: update profile_enterprise_application set status = 'WAITING', version = version + 1, update_time = current_timestamp, update_by = #{operatorId} where enterprise_application_id = #{applicationId} and status = 'OVERRIDE_PENDING' and decision_version = #{decisionVersion} and del_flag = '0'

update profile_enterprise_application set status = 'INVALID', decision_source = 'ADMIN_OVERRIDE', decision_result = 'REJECTED', decision_reason = #{reason}, finished_time = #{now}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now}, update_by = #{operatorId} where enterprise_application_id = #{applicationId} and status = 'OVERRIDE_PENDING' and decision_version = #{decisionVersion} and del_flag = '0'

update profile_decision_record set decision_status = 'FINAL', occurred_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now}, update_by = #{operatorId}, version = version + 1 where profile_type = 'ENTERPRISE' and application_id = #{applicationId} and decision_version = #{decisionVersion} and decision_source = 'ADMIN_OVERRIDE' and decision_status = 'PENDING' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into profile_enterprise(enterprise_profile_id, previous_profile_id, current_version_id, enterprise_name, unified_credit_code, enterprise_type, legal_representative_name, legal_document_type_code, legal_document_number, established_date, business_term_from, business_term_until, registered_address, business_scope, contact_name, contact_phone, email, registered_capital, industry_code, website, status, version, create_dept, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, del_flag) values(#{profileId}, null, null, #{enterpriseName}, #{unifiedCreditCode}, #{enterpriseType}, #{legalRepresentativeName}, #{legalDocumentTypeCode}, #{legalDocumentNumber}, #{establishedDate}, #{businessTermFrom}, #{businessTermUntil}, #{registeredAddress}, #{businessScope}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{email}, #{registeredCapital}, #{industryCode}, #{website}, 'ACTIVE', 0, -1, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId}, '0')

insert into profile_enterprise_source(enterprise_source_id, enterprise_profile_id, source_type, operator_user_id, operation_reason, enterprise_name, unified_credit_code, identity_key, enterprise_type, legal_representative_name, legal_document_type_code, legal_document_number, established_date, business_term_from, business_term_until, registered_address, business_scope, contact_name, contact_phone, email, registered_capital, industry_code, website, field_snapshot_json, occurred_time, version, create_dept, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, del_flag) values(#{sourceId}, #{profileId}, #{sourceType}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{enterpriseName}, #{unifiedCreditCode}, #{identityKey}, #{enterpriseType}, #{legalRepresentativeName}, #{legalDocumentTypeCode}, #{legalDocumentNumber}, #{establishedDate}, #{businessTermFrom}, #{businessTermUntil}, #{registeredAddress}, #{businessScope}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{email}, #{registeredCapital}, #{industryCode}, #{website}, #{json}, #{now}, 0, -1, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId}, '0')

insert into profile_enterprise_version(enterprise_version_id, enterprise_profile_id, version_no, source_type, source_id, enterprise_name, unified_credit_code, enterprise_type, legal_representative_name, legal_document_type_code, legal_document_number, established_date, business_term_from, business_term_until, registered_address, business_scope, contact_name, contact_phone, email, registered_capital, industry_code, website, status, published_time, version, create_dept, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, del_flag) values(#{versionId}, #{profileId}, #{versionNo}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{enterpriseName}, #{unifiedCreditCode}, #{enterpriseType}, #{legalRepresentativeName}, #{legalDocumentTypeCode}, #{legalDocumentNumber}, #{establishedDate}, #{businessTermFrom}, #{businessTermUntil}, #{registeredAddress}, #{businessScope}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{email}, #{registeredCapital}, #{industryCode}, #{website}, 'CURRENT', #{now}, 0, -1, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId}, '0')
mapper.update: update profile_enterprise set current_version_id = #{versionId}, enterprise_name = #{enterpriseName}, unified_credit_code = #{unifiedCreditCode}, enterprise_type = #{enterpriseType}, legal_representative_name = #{legalRepresentativeName}, legal_document_type_code = #{legalDocumentTypeCode}, legal_document_number = #{legalDocumentNumber}, established_date = #{establishedDate}, business_term_from = #{businessTermFrom}, business_term_until = #{businessTermUntil}, registered_address = #{registeredAddress}, business_scope = #{businessScope}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, email = #{email}, registered_capital = #{registeredCapital}, industry_code = #{industryCode}, website = #{website}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now}, update_by = #{operatorId} where enterprise_profile_id = #{profileId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and version = #{expectedVersion} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into profile_enterprise_binding(enterprise_binding_id, enterprise_profile_id, user_id, status, binding_version, source_type, source_id, bound_time, version, create_dept, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, del_flag) values(#{bindingId}, #{profileId}, #{userId}, 'ACTIVE', 1, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{now}, 0, -1, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId}, '0')

insert into profile_enterprise_binding_event(enterprise_binding_event_id, enterprise_binding_id, enterprise_profile_id, user_id, event_type, binding_version, source_type, source_id, reason, occurred_time, version, create_dept, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, del_flag) values(#{eventId}, #{bindingId}, #{profileId}, #{userId}, #{eventType}, #{bindingVersion}, 'ADMIN_OVERRIDE', #{sourceId}, #{reason}, #{now}, 0, -1, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId}, '0')

insert into profile_material_ref(material_ref_id, owner_type, owner_id, profile_type, oss_id, material_node_id, material_tag_code, material_tag_name, file_name, file_size, file_extension, mime_type, status, immutable_flag, attached_time, detached_time, version, create_dept, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, del_flag) select #{newIdBase} + row_number() over(order by material_ref_id), 'SOURCE', #{sourceId}, profile_type, oss_id, material_node_id, material_tag_code, material_tag_name, file_name, file_size, file_extension, mime_type, 'ATTACHED', 'Y', #{now}, null, 0, -1, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId}, '0' from profile_material_ref where profile_type = 'ENTERPRISE' and owner_type = 'VERSION' and owner_id = #{versionId} and status = 'ATTACHED' and del_flag = '0'

insert into profile_operation_audit(operation_audit_id, profile_type, profile_id, application_id, binding_id, operation_type, operator_user_id, capability, reason, before_status, after_status, result, failure_category, occurred_time, version, create_dept, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, del_flag) values(#{auditId}, 'ENTERPRISE', #{profileId}, #{applicationId}, #{bindingId}, #{operationType}, #{operatorId}, #{capability}, #{reason}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, 'SUCCESS', null, #{now}, 0, -1, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId}, '0')
